notes_for_editor: The 1928 cabin, 1930 pole tower, 1965 destruction and 6,053-foot elevation all come from one page (firelookout.com Henry West). The Sanders County list and the Forest Fire Lookout Association list confirm the name, tower type and gone status only. No independent source for the 1928 or 1930 structures. The record's kind 'tower' fits the 1930 structure; the 1928 structure was a log cabin. No height_m recorded because the source gives 20 feet without saying whether that is the cab-floor height. A search found a different Montana lookout (Mount Henry) with similar dates; it was not used. No corrections proposed. No staffing or fire history found.
